narrator_script: [warmly] People say they want real life. [PAUSE 0.8s] They say it while their thumbs are already somewhere else. [PAUSE 0.7s] The hours have moved. Friendship happens in a chat. Courage happens later. Or never. [PAUSE 1.0s] Virtual is already winning. [PAUSE 1.1s] That used to scare me. [PAUSE 0.6s] Then I saw the opening. [PAUSE 0.7s] If the hours are already there — we still get to decide what those hours are for. [PAUSE 1.2s] I started this as a tool for my son. [PAUSE 0.7s] A place he can take a hard moment… and live a version of it… before he has to live it for real. [PAUSE 0.8s] Not a lecture. A playground. [PAUSE 1.2s] Doubland is where What if gets answered — by your Double, living the version of your life you didn’t. [PAUSE 0.7s] You and your friends put personality twins in a private village. They live. You watch. Every day you get a one-minute story of what happened. [PAUSE 0.8s] Want to see what your Double would do?
